summary: Chamath argues X is the ideal acquirer of TikTok's creator graph and video content, seeing a combination of TikTok's content with X's safer American-controlled infrastructure as a significant strategic and value-creating outcome for X.
quote: I was super excited when I saw that there was the potential that X would take over TikTok... if you can take the video content of TikTok and the graph of creators, but have a different app and a different substrate be the delivery mechanism where you know that it's much safer... that to me would be the compromise.
